##### Project general facts

Nikki Beach Residences by Aldar is the first branded residential project in the emirate, created in partnership with the globally celebrated Nikki Beach lifestyle brand. The community comprises three residential towers rising from a ground floor to between eighteen and twenty residential floors, with design and interiors in beige, wood, grey and metallic tones. The collection offers one-, two-, three- and four-bedroom apartments, five-bedroom sky terraces and five-bedroom sky villas, available furnished and unfurnished.

Residents enjoy a five-star resort experience with direct beach access, a beach clubhouse, a beach lounge and beach sports. Amenities include a swimming pool and splash pad, an outdoor gym, a gym with dance and yoga studio, a yoga deck, a sauna and treatment room, a library, a family lounge, a games room, a co-working space, indoor and outdoor kids' play areas and relaxing gardens, while a food and beverage retail strip and convenience retail add everyday comfort.

Spacious apartments feature habitable balconies, smart automated blinds and a residents' app, and selected units are ready for short-term rental. The community is pet friendly and pursues wellness and sustainability certifications, with electric vehicle chargers and bicycle parking on site. Round-the-clock concierge, valet parking and housekeeping are complemented by a la carte services and exclusive Nikki Beach member benefits. Homes are delivered with fitted kitchens, with furnished options also available.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is a group of reclaimed coral-shaped islands off the coast of Ras Al Khaimah, known for its pristine beaches, turquoise waters and resort atmosphere. The Wynn Al Marjan Island integrated resort, DoubleTree by Hilton and Rixos Bab Al Bahr sit alongside beach clubs, restaurants and waterfront promenades, creating a lively coastal setting for residents and visitors throughout the year.

Al Hamra Village, with its golf course, marina and mall, is a short drive away, and Mina Al Arab is also close by. Ras Al Khaimah International Airport is easily reached, while Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road connects residents with Sharjah, Dubai and Dubai International Airport, keeping the wider region within comfortable driving distance for business and leisure, while schools and clinics serve families nearby.

Al Marjan Island is a freehold destination open to international buyers, with full foreign ownership and no personal income tax. The arrival of the Wynn integrated resort is driving strong growth in tourism, hospitality and short-term rental demand across the island. Branded beachfront residences in a managed resort community appeal to both investors seeking rental income and buyers looking for a coastal second home.
